name: Seafile

lifecycle.note: The shared recipe targets stable Community Edition 13.0.28; the 14.0 documentation is published, but only 14.0 testing image tags were available at the vendor registry when checked. Professional Edition has a different image and dependencies.

security: Keep the private HTTP bind private; require TLS before exposing the service, and recover database and file data together.
pitfalls: The official image uses initial-admin, database, and JWT environment secrets; Docker operators can inspect container environment.
The shared recipe verifies administrator login only; library/file round-trip, client sync, restart persistence, and isolated restore remain separate acceptance gates.
Seafile's configured hostname and protocol must match the selected access route, including a nondefault host port.
